message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. Facts: Defendant Wang fabricated trademark packaging of Wuliangye and Xifeng (registered trademarks) and sold them. This is counterfeit trademark goods. In Chinese criminal law, offense is "侵犯商标专用权罪" (Trademark infringement) or "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". The statutory name: "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". According to correction rule: list only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品". Also maybe "伪造注册商标标识罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 205 of Criminal Law: "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品" is crime. So we list that.

Any other offenses? He also forged trademark packaging, which is part of same offense. No other crimes like fraud, etc. So single offense.

Thus output: [罪名]生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品<eoa>
